summary: Comprehensive test suite covering core requirements: cartesian products, exclude/include rules, fail-fast, max-parallel, max-size validation, and workflow structure. Well-organized with clear test names, external fixtures, and end-to-end act integration. Error handling is well-tested (invalid JSON, missing files, oversized matrix, no dimensions). Minor gaps: single-dimension matrices (os-only, versions-only, features-only), empty array handling, and dimension-ordering edge cases untested. Test fixtures not shown, but referenced consistently. The run_normalized() helper and grep-chain assertions introduce minor brittleness but are workable. Would reliably catch regressions in main features and workflow integration, though corner cases might slip through.
